name: Order In The Church
overview: Scripture reveals that the church is designed as a unified body with diverse roles, each member serving a distinct function as described in Romans 12:4. Christ is established as the supreme head over the church, exercising authority over all things (Ephesians 1:22). To maintain order and spiritual health, God has appointed various leaders such as apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers to equip the saints (Ephesians 4:11). Furthermore, the responsibility to organize and establish elders in every local church is emphasized, ensuring that what is lacking is set in proper order, as instructed in Titus 1:5.
